name: shape-single-read
description: Single agent with one read tool.
task: Assess the current state of the sales domain and recommend one next step.
yaml:
version: '1'
system:
  name: Shape A — single agent, one read tool
  domain: sales
  visibility: Personal
entrypoint: reader
state:
  channels:
    messages: add_messages
grants:
  data: []
  knowledge: []
  metrics: []
  tools:
    - search_knowledge
  connections: []
agents:
  - id: reader
    role: Reads the granted knowledge and answers
    agent_md: |
      # reader
      Answer the question from the granted knowledge only. Cite what you used.
    memory_md: '# Memory'
    tools:
      - search_knowledge

response.content: plan(reader): 1. use the first granted tool  2. answer the task.
